description: Apply a custom resolution (provided by the LLM or user) to a specific conflict hunk. Replaces the conflict markers at the given line range with the provided content. Writes WITHOUT validating the result (no marker or syntax check): for an agent's own resolution prefer gitwand_resolve_hunk_llm, which validates before writing.

content.description: The resolved content to replace the conflict block with. An empty string removes the block entirely.

cwd.description: Working directory (repo root). Defaults to server cwd.

file.description: Path to the conflicted file (relative to cwd).

line.description: Start line of the conflict hunk (the <<<<<<< line).

name: gitwand_apply_resolution
